mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_visitor(fingerprint,first_visit_time,last_visit_time) VALUES(#{fingerprint},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fingerprint=VALUES(fingerprint)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_visitor WHERE fingerprint=#{fingerprint} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM blog_visitor WHERE visitor_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT v.visitor_id,v.fingerprint,v.ip_address,v.user_agent,v.country,v.province,v.city, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM blog_page_view pv WHERE pv.visitor_id=v.visitor_id) AS total_views, v.is_blocked,v.blocked_until,v.first_visit_time,v.last_visit_time,v.create_time,v.update_time FROM blog_visitor v
